en.headline: Hong Kong Wine & Dine Festival set for 29 October to 1 November
en.dek: The Hong Kong Tourism Board said the annual event will return to the Central Harbourfront Event Space with more than 300 booths, new country pavilions and a month of citywide culinary follow-up activities.
body: The Hong Kong Tourism Board has announced that the 2026 Hong Kong Wine & Dine Festival will take place from 29 October to 1 November at the Central Harbourfront Event Space.

Organisers said the four-day event will feature more than 300 booths offering wines from established and emerging regions, including new pavilions from Australia, Canada and South Korea, alongside dining partners and live entertainment against the Victoria Harbour skyline.

A new “Only in Hong Kong” flavours programme will involve more than 100 restaurants, hotels and local eateries. The festival will be followed by a month-long citywide culinary campaign. Further ticketing and programme details are to be released closer to the event.

zh.headline: 香港美酒佳餚巡禮定於10月29日至11月1日舉行
zh.dek: 旅發局宣布年度盛事重臨中環海濱活動空間，設逾300個攤位、新增多個國家展館，並有「只在香港」風味活動及全城美食跟進推廣。
body: 香港旅遊發展局公布，2026年香港美酒佳餚巡禮將於10月29日至11月1日在中環海濱活動空間舉行。
主辦方表示，一連四日活動將設超過300個攤位，匯聚來自傳統及新興產區的美酒，包括澳洲、加拿大及韓國等全新展館，並有餐飲夥伴及現場娛樂，以維港景色為背景。
今年新增「只在香港」風味環節，超過100間餐廳、酒店及本地食肆參與。巡禮結束後將有為期一個月的全城美食推廣活動，票務及詳細節目稍後公布。
